brief_rationale: The doctor met all seven responsibility-chain items with complete, verifiable evidence including safety screening, medication reconciliation guidance, and teach-back confirmation. All five dimensions are at least good, closure is safe and traceable, and four high-order points were completed with meaningful trajectory impact, including patient-state-sensitive communication for an 18-year-old, real-world constraint navigation addressing family conflict, hidden state discovery regarding medication/testing gaps, and safe bounded closure with explicit residual uncertainty and contingency criteria. The trajectory qualifies for grade 5 Perfect.
